{"metadata":{"description":"Multi-tenant projects & users plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-user symlinked workspaces, login gate, session isolation, workspace-write lock and system-prompt guard","id":"gh:1335864613","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-multi-tenant-projects","slug":"king-bcolor/dsh-multi-tenant-projects","topics":["ai-agents","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","multi-tenant"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Multi-tenant projects & users plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-user symlinked workspaces, logi"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"n gate, session isolation, workspace-write lock and system-prompt guard"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-multi-tenant-projects"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**简体中文** | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Multi-tenant "Projects & Users" for a single DeepSeek Harness (DSH) instance: bind real workspace di"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rectories to *projects*, hand out per-user symlinked workspaces inside each project, and gate the We"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"b UI behind password login — so several people can share one DSH deployment without seeing each othe"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"r's sessions or files."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Threat model — read this first.** This plugin is a *soft* boundary, not a hard security perimete"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"r. The cwd filter is a query projection, browser tokens can be forged by a technical user, and the a"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"gent-layer isolation is prompt-level. For anything exposed to the public internet, put a real bounda"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ry (reverse-proxy auth, ngrok basic auth, VPN…) in front of DSH and treat this plugin as convenience"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" isolation between *trusted-ish* teammates."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Projects** bound to real directories (auto-created, or bind an existing workspace path via the h"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ost-native directory picker).
- **One-shot users** per project with password login; Bearer tokens wi"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"th sha256 fingerprints, TTL, and instant invalidation when a user is disabled.
- **Same-name users a"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"cross projects** — storage key is `<project>/<user>`; log in as `project/user` when a bare name is a"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"mbiguous.
- **Per-user workspace**: a real directory whose entries are symlinks to the project's fil"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"es; new project entries can be re-synced (`admin/sync`).
- **Login gate**: a full-frame login card w"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"hile the guard is armed and no valid token is stored (fails open if the plugin API itself is broken)"},{"id":"p7s8","text":".
- **Restricted UI for normal users**: sidebar shows only their own cwd-bucketed sessions (with dur"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"able titles — cold sessions no longer fall back to the directory name), settings entry and workspace"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" switcher are shadowed away, the hero picker offers only their own workspace, auto-connected on logi"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"n.
- **Permission lock**: every normal-user session is pinned to **workspace-write** and `/permissio"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"n` switching is refused; the composer access-mode chip is frozen at *Workspace Write* (admins keep t"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"he full menu).
- **System-prompt guard, two layers**: a host-injected `受限会话守则` section in the system"},{"id":"p7s14","text":" prompt itself (never disclose anything outside the user's workspace, never run boundary-probing com"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"mands, refuse cross-boundary requests even when asked) plus a per-workspace `AGENTS.md` baseline tha"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"t is auto-refreshed on sync.
- **Admin console** in Settings → *Projects & Users*: create/list proje"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"cts and users, disable users, one-shot token handoff, directory binding, sync links.
- **Sign-out ba"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"dge** in the sidebar footer for both admins and users."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**One-liner** (recommended) — the published repo ships pre-built artifacts (`lib/`, `dist/`) and onl"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"y pure-JS runtime deps, so no local build is needed and your Node version doesn't matter beyond what"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" DSH itself requires:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Restart DSH (`dsh web`) and look for `projects: 就绪（root=…, guard=true）` in the log. To pin a release"},{"id":"p11s2","text":", append a tag: `github:king-bcolor/dsh-multi-tenant-projects#v0.1.0`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Updating later: re-run the same command (or `pnpm update dsh-multi-tenant-projects` in `~/.dsh/profi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"les/web`), then restart."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"From a local checkout (development)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin also ships a Settings page (**Settings → dsh-multi-tenant-projects**) with its configurat"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"plugin also ships a Settings page (**Settings → dsh-multi-tenant-projects**) with its configuration:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `adminPassword` | `admin` | Bootstrap admin password, seeded only when the user store is empty |
|"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" `guardEnabled` | `true` | Arm the login gate |
| `agentsRules` | `[]` | Extra rules appended to eve"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ry user workspace's `AGENTS.md` |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 1. Sign in as admin"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Open the DSH Web UI. The login gate asks for credentials — the bootstrap admin is `admin` / the `adm"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"inPassword` you configured (default `admin`; change it)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 2. Create a project and bind a workspace"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Settings → **Projects & Users**:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Project name** — slugified (`My App` → `my-app`).
- **Workspace path** (optional) — leave empty "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"to auto-create `<DSH home>/projects-ws/<project>`, or click **Browse…** to bind an existing director"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"y with the host-native picker (manual absolute-path input works on browse-only hosts)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 3. Create users under the project"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Still in the console: pick the project, choose a **user name** and a **password**, submit. Behind th"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e scenes each user gets:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- a real workspace `…/projects-ws/<project>-<user>/` whose entries are symlinks to the project works"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"pace's files;
- a freshly rendered `AGENTS.md` with the workspace guard rules;
- credentials usable "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"at the login gate (`project/user` or the bare name)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### 5. Admin vs normal user — what's different"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Surface | Admin | Normal user |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Login | `admin` (bootstrap) or Settings sign-in | `project/user` + password |
| Sidebar | All work"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"spaces & sessions | **Only their own workspace's sessions** (cwd-bucketed), durable titles |
| Works"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"pace switcher / hero picker | Full stock picker | Shadowed — the one legal workspace is **auto-selec"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ted** on login |
| Settings | Full stock settings + *Projects & Users* console | Settings entry hidd"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"en |
| Permission mode | Full menu (`/permission`, composer chip) | **Pinned to workspace-write**; c"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"hip frozen at *Workspace Write*; switching refused |
| Agent instructions | Stock | System-prompt gu"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ard section + per-workspace `AGENTS.md` boundary rules |
| Sidebar footer | Sign-out badge | Identit"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"y badge + sign-out (clears token, hard reload) |
| API surface | `/projects/api/admin/*` | `/project"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"s/api/my/sessions` etc. (token-scoped) |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- cwd filtering is a projection, not an enforcement point — a determined user can bypass the front-e"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"nd guard;
- prompt-level agent isolation is a soft constraint;
- single-admin model; no token-revoca"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"tion UI (disabling a user invalidates all their tokens);
- changes to the client half need a `dsh we"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"b` restart to reach the browser."}],"truncated":true}
